note: Agent-eval corpus for GitHub Copilot driving the WalletWall plugin. These cases test how a model USES and DESCRIBES WalletWall results. They are not MCP conformance tests: the MCP structured results are proven by the conformance, adversarial, mutation and privacy suites. Prose is non-deterministic; the graders here are heuristics and every recorded run also carries a manual verdict.
placeholders: {{bundle}} and {{evaluatedAt}} are replaced by the compact JSON of the referenced conformance case or Evidence Explorer fixture.
